moves.name: Jab 1
moves.notes: Startup and total frames assumes player presses and releases A/B in one frame, or buffers the attack. Transitions to jab 2 on frame 10

moves.name: Jab 2
moves.notes: Transitions to rapid jab on frame 14 or jab 3 on frame 15

moves.name: Forward Tilt, Dragon
moves.notes: Endlag on hit is 28. Endlag on block is 39. Can fire other arm beginning on frame 17. Min Min can move and jump at any point of the animation

moves.name: Forward Tilt, Ramram
moves.notes: Can fire other arm beginning on frame 17. Projectile does not launch if blocked. Endlag is 37 if blocked.

moves.name: Forward Tilt, Megawatt
moves.notes: Can fire other arm beginning on frame 17. Endlag on hit is 22-29 depending on how far the arm must retract. Endlag on block is 40-44 depending on how far the arm must retract.

moves.name: Up Tilt
moves.notes: Sweetspots are Min Min's feet, legs are sourspots.

moves.name: Down Tilt
moves.notes: leg intangibility on frame 10-14

moves.name: Forward Smash, Dragon (Laser)
moves.notes: Charge hold frame 8. Can fire other arm beginning on frame 17. Endlag on hit is 30. Endlag on block is 40-41 depending on how far the arm must retract. You cannot fire the beam if you already made contact with a shield or clanked

moves.name: Forward Smash, Ramram
moves.notes: Can fire other arm beginning on frame 17. Projectile does not launch if blocked. Endlag is 39 if blocked. Charge hold frame 8.

moves.name: Forward Smash, Megawatt
moves.notes: Charge hold frame 8. Can fire other arm beginning on frame 17. Endlag on hit is 22-31 depending on how far the arm must retract. Endlag on block is 41-47 depending on how far the arm must retract.

moves.name: Up Smash
moves.notes: leg intangibility on frame 7-15. Reflects on frame 6-15. Charge hold frame 2

moves.name: Down Smash
moves.notes: leg intangibility on frame 6-8. Charge hold frame 2

moves.name: Neutral Air, Dragon
moves.notes: arm intangible on frame 10-23. autocancels on frame 1-3 and 37 onward

moves.name: Neutral Air, Ramram
moves.notes: arm intangible on frame 8-18. autocancels on frame 1-3 and 28 onward

moves.name: Neutral Air, Megawatt
moves.notes: arm intangible on frame 14-32. autocancels on frame 1-5 and 50 onward

moves.name: Up Air
moves.notes: autocancels on frame 29 onward

moves.name: Down Air
moves.notes: landing hit on frame 1 of landing. Autocancels on frame 41 onward

moves.name: Up B (Arms Jump)
moves.notes: Invulnerable 8—13 normally and 18—25 when held.

moves.name: Up B (Arms Hook)
moves.notes: Tethers to ledge on frame 5. Endlag on hit is 22-32 depending on how far the arm must restract. Endlag on block is 40-42 depending on how far the arm must restract.

moves.name: Down B (Arms Change)
moves.notes: Instantaneous.

moves.name: Grab
moves.notes: ARMS don't have hurtboxes on frames 18-38

moves.name: Dash Grab
moves.notes: ARMS don't have hurtboxes on frames 18-38

moves.name: Pivot Grab
moves.notes: ARMS don't have hurtboxes on frames 18-38

moves.name: Pummel
moves.notes: total frames includes 14 frames of hitlag (plus one in 1v1)

moves.name: Forward Throw
moves.notes: Hits on frame 12, throws on frame 13.

moves.name: Backward Throw
moves.notes: Hits on frame 27, throws on frame 31.

moves.name: Up Throw
moves.notes: Hits on frame 10, throws on frame 11.

moves.name: Down Throw
moves.notes: Hits on frame 15, throws on frame 16.

moves.name: Spot Dodge
moves.notes: Intangible on frame 3—17.

moves.name: Forward Roll
moves.notes: Intangible on frame 4-15.

moves.name: Backward Roll
moves.notes: Intangible on frame 5-16.

moves.name: Neutral Air Dodge
moves.notes: Intangible on frame 3-30.

moves.name: Air Dodge, Down
moves.notes: Intangible on frame 3-21

moves.name: Air Dodge, Diagonally Down
moves.notes: Intangible on frame 3-21

moves.name: Air Dodge, Left/Right
moves.notes: Intangible on frame 3-21

moves.name: Air Dodge, Diagonally Up
moves.notes: Intangible on frame 3-21

moves.name: Air Dodge, Up
